admission.justification: Replaying a request must never prepare twice or start a second seat; the order of validation against effect is what makes that observable.

applicability: Every role start that reaches the first-run preparation path, including a repeated request id.
conditions: An invalid document reference or an archived request id is refused before any durable effect.
An existing receipt is reconciled without a second preparation.
exclusions: A start whose role needs no preparation at all.

evidence: a2/native-review.md N6; final-a3/source-witnesses.md; unchanged execution owner.

statement: A role start validates its selection and request lineage before durable preparation and reconciles same-request receipts without unnecessary mutation.
